issue.title: Codex: compare zero-crossing Casanya with Gonek/LeClair and audit max zero-wise error
issue.body:
# NEXT CODEX TASK — zero-crossing Casanya vs Gonek/LeClair, maximum zero-by-zero errors

User request: Replace the exclusive use of old Casanya c667 (962 nonpositive gaps) with an **additional, genuine monotone version with zero crossings**. Keep c667 for reference; do **not** delete or overwrite previous benchmark. Communicate results via this GitHub issue and versioned artifacts under `chatgpt/benchmark_CGL_20261021/`.

## 1. Candidate and reproducible implementation
- A standalone truth-free constructor `chatgpt/benchmark_CGL_20261021/casanya_monotone_projection.py` has been committed. Inspect/run it; its input is prime-based c667 `zCasanya.bin` plus `zLamb.bin`. It applies full-array isotonic PAV to `u_k = x_k - 0.10 tau_k`, then reconstructs `y_k = PAV(u)_k + 0.10 tau_k`.
- A project attachment `zCasanya_monotona_10pctRvM.bin` exists (2,001,052 float64 little-endian) with SHA256 `2857d9e8c85c4197ebeab052df16ea8defb82650ce3078ba37fb918dfbfb60ef`; description `zCasanya_monotona_10pctRvM.txt` reports exactly 0 gaps, RMS shift 0.001769170777. If accessible in the original MATLAB folder, compare to re-created output. Do not assume it exists at a particular local path: locate explicitly.
- A separate MATLAB experimental `work/benchmark_casanya_gonek_leclair_20261021/zCasanya0_optimizar.m` exists. It searches cutoffs [512,2048,8192] and PAV alphas [0.01, 0.05, 0.10, 0.20], then produces `zCasanya0.bin`; **this is not the same as the fixed 0.10 post-processed c667**. Treat separately and avoid training leakage.
- The *supervised* `zCasanyaX_ideal.txt` uses true zeros to fit a predictor: **separate this from any prime-only, no-oracle claim**. If included, clearly mark training/test splits and keep off the primary prime-only leaderboard.
- Check provenance: SHA256 of `zCasanya.bin` from a current shared attachment is `dc8d4be907366056825da86ed4ebe2371d5c071c2dbf2bc64fc36501fe38e607`, whereas prior Codex report identifies a different reconstructed/original c667 SHA256 `64d1de134e920c1eb89f61ba5d93c7f949b343bfa0d9ebf5da6fb647c2d790d9`. Their RMS values agree to printed precision but the bytes differ; reconcile and report both hashes, never silently substitute datasets.

Independent check on the current shared attachments (float64, all 2,001,052):
| Metric | c667 | c667 + PAV alpha=0.1 |
|---|---:|---:|
| RMS full | 0.04398854715234 | 0.04382588764892 |
| RMS final 600316 | 0.04055445491266 | 0.04038889123022 |
| Maximum absolute error | 1.35755097407 | 1.35755097407 |
| Number of nonpositive adjacent gaps | 962 | 0 |
| Minimum synthetic adjacent gap | -0.25252443040 | +0.05191863887 |
These are measurements **on these attached binaries**; independently recheck before including in official benchmark.

## 2. ESSENTIAL metric: worst individual zero-by-zero error and local-gap threshold
For every method on the *same* fixed ordinal labels k report all of:
- `e_k = gamma_true[k] - gamma_model[k]` signed error, `max |e_k|` and its index k, MAE and percentiles, not merely RMS;
- `a_k = gamma_model[k+1]-gamma_model[k]`, min/max gaps and number of `a_k<=0`;
- `d_k = min(a_{k-1},a_k)` for interior k (at endpoints use the single neighbor), compute `R_k = 2 |e_k|/d_k` **only for d_k>0**; for d_k<=0 record structural failure separately. Report **maximum R**, location and count of `R_k>=1`; stratify by height, first 1000, last 300, last 600316, all 2001052, and accurately the existing benchmark's fixed pilot index sample.
- The exact pairwise gap margin `m_k = a_k - (e_{k+1}-e_k)` if e is defined `gamma_model - gamma_true`, otherwise adjust sign consistently; note numerically `m_k = gamma_true[k+1] - gamma_true[k]`. It is an *identity depending on true data*, not an independent theorem or predictive criterion. Do not use it to suggest RH was proved.
- Mathematical finite sufficient test: if a_k>0 for all k and `|gamma_model[k]-gamma_true[k]| < (1/2)*min(a_{k-1},a_k)` for **every** k (with endpoint convention), then true ordinates strictly increase and this would imply RH+simplicity **only if proved for all k**, not verified on a finite file. An unnormalized error <0.5 or half *mean* spacing is not sufficient. Clearly report violation counts.
- For attached PAV 0.1 array, an independent finite check gives maximum R ≈ 9.51309 and 49,353 indices failing R<1 over 2,001,052; verify because the RMS improvement does NOT establish this strong RH-relevant inequality.

## 3. Fair comparisons, particularly low vs high ordinates
- Compare **Casanya raw** and **Casanya + PAV** against exact LeClair 2016 and Gonek 2012 on the same k and matched distinct-prime budget, including 97-prime and 1028-prime tiers when applicable. Clearly state Casanya PAV uses no extra primes; report its extra computational cost.
- For symmetry in assessing the value of monotonic post-processing, include an **optional PAV(alpha=0.1) post-processing of Gonek and LeClair too**, separately from their original algorithms (not label these as Gonek or LeClair originals).
- Validate global root enumeration/ordinal identity for LeClair/Gonek BEFORE global winner declarations; preserve documented multiple LeClair solutions at k=1, b=8191 and v17 k=2 missing.
- Existing 1000-index pilot deliberately oversamples low indices and is not a representative global RMS; the 'last 300' is the appropriate preselected higher-height performance check but had some earlier exposure and is not genuinely never-seen. Report results for the whole **final 600316-index region** only if all methods computed, plus true consecutive early k=1..1000 and comparable high consecutive windows; disclose parameter-selection boundaries.
- Low zeros already verified on the critical line; improvements there matter for engineering/RMS but not as independent progress toward RH.

## 4. Next outputs
Create new versioned source scripts and tables. Include hashes and a concise note differentiating empirical (finite) max-error calculations, true root indexing, PAV monotonicity and what would require a uniform theorem for all k. Do not alter original zCasanya/zLamb/zeross binaries, existing official report, source papers or manuscript versions.

Report progress / blockers in this issue. Do not fabricate a completed Gonek vs LeClair whole-range comparison while global ordinal root matching remains unvalidated.
